_guide: The list upgrades' effect classes, read from the book by hand (work queue J1, Codex review 10.9.2026). audit_upgrades.py checks that every list upgrade row offered on a ship's card hits exactly one class and that the effect the class requires is in the data. Classes: stat = mod/set (the stats line changes), weapon = swp/add/del/sw (a weapon row changes), text = the card's upgrade box states the book's rule (the book section's own sentence, the row's desc or a rule bound with domain.js's up key), fleet = a fleet-level purchase with no per-ship effect. Commander rows (at -> a commander) and rows covered by the ship's own option are not classified: they print on the commander card or drop out of the offer. The first matching row wins.

A Mark that comes built in, 0 points, a locked info row (J142). The barges p.260-266: 'This ship bears the Mark of X as part of its point cost'; the Daemonships p.248/250/252: the Mark 'already included in the cost'. The row's desc is the book's sentence; no mod key, because the profile already includes the Mark (Terminus Est hp 13) and the Daemonship row carries Nurgle's +1 hp. The label is without 'The' on purpose, so the card's Mark rules and mark_paid do not trigger a second time.
